Name: Style-Compromise Artisan Good Icons (SCAGI)
Author: Cheerybelle
Description:
One problem with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url] and similar mods is that a lot of people don't make icons and patches for it [size=1](when I wrote this, anyway)[/size], so there hasn't been significant coverage.
I noticed this and decided to address the issue myself, partly because it bugged me, and partly just for the lark. [size=1](It was kinda fun... well, at first, anyway.)[/size]

~ What's up with the name? ~
Style-Compromise Artisan Good Icons is so-called because it is a style somewhere between vanilla Stardew and the Vamp/Rjenyawd/RabidMuffins/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26612284]paradigmnomad[/url] style used by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2925]PPJA Icon Pack[/url].
The wine icon style is somewhere between Rjenyawd's style and vanilla, and the Jellies' and Pickles' jars are similar to those of vanilla Honey, which is, in turn, similar to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2925]PPJA[/url] style.
It's designed to not look too out of place alongside [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vanilla_software]vanilla[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1935]PPJA[/url] assets.
(SCAGI 3 r2): The mead icons are heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66352491]SilentOak's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3609]Quality Products[/url] style.

~ Do I need to have every supported mod installed? ~
No, you don't.
In fact, you can't, as certain mods conflict with eachother.
Some supported mods might not even work on the current version of Stardew Valley, either.
You don't need to have any of the supported mods installed, actually.
There won't be any graphical glitches if you lack supported mods, either.
You only need [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url] [size=1](SCAGI 1.1.0 - 3.3.0) [/size]/ [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]EBAGI[/url] [size=1](SCAGI 3.4.0 Onwards)[/size].

[color=#9fc5e8]! NEW in SCAGI 3 Release 2: Style-Compromise Better Mead Icons !
[/color][color=#cfe2f3]The patches that add the mead icons require the[/color] [url=https://github.com/daleao/bagi-meads/releases]BAGI Mead Addon[/url] [color=#dd7e6b](GitHub)[/color] [color=#cfe2f3]to work.
You will also need a mod such as[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Meads[/url][color=#cfe2f3] to get the mead icons to appear.
Note: Mead support icons are not available yet for Stardew Valley v1.6.x.[/color]

[size=3][color=#00ffff]There is also a "Lite" version for Stardew Valley 1.6.x. Check it out for more details:[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20755]SCAGI Lite[/url][/size]

!! Warning !! - SCAGI Vanilla will conflict with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2925]PPJA Default Icon Pack[/url], causing missing textures.
SCAGI Vanilla doesn't conflict with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2925]PPJA Icon Pack[/url], though, so you can still use that.

 ~ Does this mod have support icons for honey types only obtainable through mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5399]Adaptable Bee House[/url]? ~
- Yes. The icons should appear in normal gameplay, as those mods don't add new honey items.

~ Does this mod have support icons for the [url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10227321]PFM Flower Jelly[/url] mod? [color=#dd7e6b](Postype) [/color]~
- Yes. The icons should appear in normal gameplay, as that mod doesn't add a new jelly item.

~ Plans for the Future? ~
If I continue working on this mod, I may add [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url] support for more mods that lack [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url] support.
I likely won't be doing any more patches for mods that add lots of new produce, though.
